goal_summary: Deliver a serverless backend and headless storefront for the E-Commerce MVP, ensuring atomic inventory updates and integrating Stripe + FedEx/USPS.
preserved_behavior: WooCommerce standard order states: Pending_Payment -> Processing -> Completed.

slices.description: Initialize Cloudflare Worker with Hono.js. Setup Wrangler and create D1 schema migrations for products, variants, orders, and customers.
Define API definitions for Catalog, Cart, and Checkout domains using @hono/zod-openapi for future SDK generation.
Implement D1 queries for Product listings and details. Apply cache control headers.
Scaffold Next.js storefront project on Cloudflare Pages. Setup routing for Home and Product Detail pages.
Implement cart API endpoints and integrate external HTTP fetch to FedEx/USPS APIs with KV caching for shipping rates.
Implement Stripe Intent generation and Webhook validation. Create atomic D1 transaction logic to reduce inventory upon payment success.
Implement Scheduled Worker (Cron Triggers) to cancel unpaid orders over 30 minutes old and restore inventory.
Implement Checkout Page with Stripe Elements. Integrate shipping option selection.
Setup CI/CD to auto-generate openapi.json and compile Client SDKs for Mobile/Marketplace consumers.
Implement API Key management middleware for Marketplace partners and UTM/Affiliate ID tracking for orders in D1.
Implement secure Admin API endpoints (CRUD for Products, Categories, Orders, Refunds) protected by Cloudflare Access or Admin JWT.
Scaffold internal Admin Dashboard (React/Vite or Next.js) using Refine.dev or react-admin to consume Admin API for managing store operations.
Implement End-User Authentication (JWT) and Customer Portal APIs (Profile, Address Book, Order History).
Implement 'My Account' area in Next.js Storefront for registered users to manage addresses and view order history.

impact_radius: Database Schema Constraints (Stock must not drop below 0)
Payment Webhook Idempotency (Prevent double-processing of Stripe events)
API Key Security & SDK Versioning for external partners
Admin Auth Bypass (Must secure admin endpoints rigorously)
Customer PII Security & IDOR (Users must only access their own profile/addresses)

quality_gates.tests: Miniflare unit tests for API; Vitest for UI components. Stripe Webhook mock tests required.
quality_gates.review: Code review finding required for DB Transaction logic and Stripe Signature validation.
quality_gates.build: Wrangler bundle size must stay under 1MB. ESLint and Prettier passing.
quality_gates.security: Stripe secret keys must be securely stored in Wrangler secrets, not plain text.

rollout_notes: Deploy D1 migrations first. Then deploy API worker. Finally deploy Pages storefront. Validate Stripe Webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard.
rollback_notes: Use 'wrangler rollback' for API worker. DB rollbacks require manual migration down-scripts.
documentation_deltas: Document local development setup using Miniflare and local D1.
